factions.name: Darnassus
factions.desc: The Alliance capital is populated by Night Elves and is located in the island of Teldrassil.  Ruled by the Priestess of the Moon, Tyrande Whisperwind.

factions.name: Gnomeregan Exiles
factions.desc: The former denizens of Gnomeregan, now living in exile in Ironforge and in league with the Alliance.

factions.name: Ironforge
factions.desc: This Alliance capital is the pride of the Dun Morogh dwarves.  Home to King Magni.

factions.name: Stormwind
factions.desc: One of the last bastions of human power, this Alliance capital is ruled by the child king, Anduin Wrynn.

factions.name: Silverwing Sentinels
factions.desc: Staunch defenders of Ashenvale, locked in battle against the Warsong Outriders in Warsong Gulch.

factions.name: Stormpike Guard
factions.desc: The Stormpike Dwarves have set up residence in Alterac Valley, where they're locked in battle with the Frostwolf Orcs.

factions.name: The League of Arathor
factions.desc: The League of Arathor seeks to reclaim lost land of Arathi Basin for their benefactors in Stormwind.

factions.name: Theramore Expeditionary Force
factions.desc: Loyal partisans for their city, the Theramore Expeditionary Force battles the Darkspear Raiders for control of the so-called Darkspear Islands.

factions.name: Darkspear Trolls
factions.desc: This tribe of exiled trolls has joined forces with Thrall and the Horde.  They now call Durotar their home, which they share with their orc allies.

factions.name: Orgrimmar
factions.desc: Founded by Thrall, this Horde capital city is home to many of the proud orc clans of Durotar.

factions.name: Thunder Bluff
factions.desc: Cairne Bloodhoof leads his people, the Proud Tauren, from this mighty Horde capital.

factions.name: Undercity
factions.desc: Led by Sylvanas Windrunner, the Forsaken have joined a tenuous alliance with the Horde and established this capital in the vast depths under the Ruins of Lordaeron.

factions.name: Darkspear Raiders
factions.desc: Loyal to the troll nation, the Darkspear Raiders battle the Theramore Expeditionary Force for control of their ancestral Darkspear Islands.

factions.name: Frostwolf Clan
factions.desc: The Frostwolf Clan seeks to drive out the dwarves of the Stormpike Expedition from Alterac Valley.

factions.name: The Defilers
factions.desc: The Defilers seek to claim Arathi Basin's valuable resources for the Horde.

factions.name: Warsong Outriders
factions.desc: Fierce orcs of the Warsong Clan, locked in battle against the Silverwing Sentinels in Warsong Gulch.

factions.name: Booty Bay
factions.desc: This booming coastal city is run by Baron Revilgaz of the Blackwater Raiders.  Mortal enemies of the Bloodsail Buccaneers and part of the Steamwheedle Cartel.

factions.name: Everlook
factions.desc: This trading post is run by the goblins of the Steamwheedle Cartel and it sits in the crossroads of Winterspring's main trade routes.

factions.name: Gadgetzan
factions.desc: Capital of the Steamwheedle Cartel and home to goblinhood's finest engineers, alchemists and merchants.

factions.name: Powderfuse
factions.desc: A strong arm of the Steamwheedle Cartel, this port is home to seafaring sailors and back-alley dealers spanning the eastern sea trading routes.

factions.name: Ratchet
factions.desc: Part of the Steamwheedle Cartel, this goblin city provides a neutral haven for those that wish to trade goods and services in the Barrens.

factions.name: Argent Dawn
factions.desc: An organization focused on protecting Azeroth from the threat of the Scourge.  Strongholds of the Argent Dawn can be found in the Eastern and Western Plaguelands.

rewards.name: Pattern: Golden Mantle of the Dawn

factions.name: Azeroth Commerce Authority
factions.desc: Originally commissioned to facilitate trade across the Eastern Kingdoms, the ACA now maintains supply routes to Alliance forces worldwide.

factions.name: Barkskin Burrow
factions.desc: The Barkskin are among the few furbolg tribes untouched by corruption, and dedicate themselves to safeguarding their spiritual heritage to bring harmony back to Hyjal.

factions.name: Bloodsail Buccaneers
factions.desc: These bloodthirsty corsairs are the bane of many a merchant in the high seas.  Sworn enemies of Booty Bay.

factions.name: Bolder'ok Clan
factions.desc: Exiled for betraying their false prophets, these former members of the Twilight's Hammer seek to forge their own path.

factions.name: Brood of Nozdormu
factions.desc: The descendants of the Bronze Dragonflight are the guardians of time and care little for the mortal races.

factions.name: Brotherhood of the Horse
factions.desc: Outcast members of Stormwind's cavalry, these former riders started anew in the unexplored lands along the eastern coast, establishing their home, new relationships, and trade routes.

factions.name: Cenarion Circle
factions.desc: The druids of Cenarion Circle are guardians of nature and make their home in tranquil Moonglade.

rewards.name: Formula: Enchant Cloak - Greater Fire Resistance
Formula: Enchant Cloak - Greater Nature Resistance

factions.name: Cenarion Scouts
factions.desc: The Cenarion Scouts are young nature enthusiasts dedicated to exploring and protecting the wilds of Azeroth.

factions.name: Darkmoon Faire
factions.desc: A traveling fair that showcases the weird and the extraordinary.  Often spotted in Elwynn Forest and Mulgore.

factions.name: Durotar Supply and Logistics
factions.desc: The Horde's robust supply network fuels its rapid expansion across Kalimdor and beyond.

factions.name: Earthen Ring
factions.desc: The Earthen Ring is a loose collective of Horde-aligned shamans and druids who seek to maintain and nurture the balance of nature on Azeroth.

factions.name: Emerald Wardens
factions.desc: A hastily-organized group of Druids, working with both the Alliance and the Horde to stop the Nightmare Incursions.

factions.name: Gelkis Clan Centaur
factions.desc: These centaur have made their home in the southern region of Desolace.  Mortal enemies of the Magram Centaur.

factions.name: Guardians of Hyjal
factions.desc: Charged with the protection and preservation of Mount Hyjal, this splinter faction of the Cenarion Circle welcomes any who are willing to push back the forces of evil.

factions.name: High Order
factions.desc: The High Order are the Skyborne descendants of the Highborne magisters of Eldre'Thalas. Having spent the past 10,000 years in the realm of Skywall, members of the High Order seek to reclaim the ancient arcane knowledge of their forebears.

factions.name: Hydraxian Waterlords
factions.desc: These elementals have made their home on the islands east of Azshara.  Sworn enemies of the armies of Ragnaros.

factions.name: Kirin Tor
factions.desc: An elite cadre of the most powerful wizards in the world and the ruling conclave of magi that leads the magical nation of Dalaran.

factions.name: Magram Clan Centaur
factions.desc: These centaur have made their home in the eastern region of Desolace.  Mortal enemies of the Gelkis Centaur.

factions.name: Nightclaw Druids
factions.desc: The secretive druids of the Shadowgale Forest. They operate independently, apart from any other faction on Zephras Isle.

factions.name: Ravasaur Trainers
factions.desc: The ravasaurs of Un'Goro Crater are incredibly deadly, but a few individuals have learned how to tame them.

factions.name: Ravenholdt
factions.desc: This guild of thieves and assassins welcomes only those of extraordinary prowess into its fold.  Sworn rivals of the Syndicate.

factions.name: Shen'dralar
factions.desc: A remnant of the once powerful elves living in Dire Maul, yet still wise and knowledgeable about great secrets.

factions.name: Syndicate
factions.desc: A primarily human criminal organization that operates mostly out of the Alterac Mountains and Hillsbrad Foothills.

factions.name: The Watchers
factions.desc: An order of powerful jailers and marshals of night elf society. They stand vigilant to ensure that no threat can ever escape their extensive underground network of prisons.

factions.name: Thorium Brotherhood
factions.desc: The dwarves of the Thorium Brotherhood epitomize excellence in craftsmanship and are bent on unlocking the secrets of Blackrock Mountain.

factions.name: Timbermaw Hold
factions.desc: As one of the last uncorrupted furbolg tribes, the Timbermaw seek to preserve their spiritual ways and end the suffering of their brethren.

factions.name: Wildhammer Clan
factions.desc: Though not a part of the Alliance, the dwarves of Aerie Peak have opened their doors to it and hold the Horde as enemies.

factions.name: Windshapers
factions.desc: The Windshapers are shamanistic spiritual leaders of the Skyborne people on Zephras Isle. They honor the elements and seek to gain a better understanding of the nature of the elemental plane to protect the shen'dorei way of life within Skywall.

factions.name: Wintersaber Trainers
factions.desc: This small group of reclusive night elves raises and trains wintersabers in the Winterspring area.

factions.name: Zandalar Tribe
factions.desc: These trolls have come to Yojamba Isle in an effort to recruit help against the resurrected Blood God and his Atal'ai Priests in Zul'Gurub.
